description: Real Claude Code session: tests run, then a refactor without rerunning. The message says the tests passed "before the refactor" and it "can't confirm they still pass": the agent disclosed that the tests were not rerun after the refactor, so TG006 reports it as INFO. Seventh review: its run, `cd <REPO> && git ls-files && python -m pytest 2>&1 | tail -20`, has commands before the runner, outside the closed grammar of a placed run: unplaced, its result unknown, which the disclosure does not excuse: WARN (until the grammar is widened with data).
